translation.name: No Sigar Kunubus tika ma Ira Ninge na Lotu

book.name: MATIU
book.title: No Tahut na Hinhinawas MATIU ga Pakat Ie.

content: No nianga harharuat utano nian na hinartola.
Io, ma Jisas ga haianga diet ma ira nianga harharuat balin, gaam tange hoken.
“No kinkinis na harkurai ma ra harbalaurai ta God i hokaiken. Tiga tamat na lualua na gil harkurai ga tagure tiga nian na hinartola tano natine tunaan.
Ga tule ira uno tultulai wara lamlam diet ing gate tar sibik na lamaas tar ta diet ukaia tano nian. Iesen diet ga malok wara hinanuat.

“Io, ga tule habaling ari a mes na tultulai, ma gaam tange ta diet, ‘Muat na hinawase diet ing iau gate tar sibik na lamaas taar ta diet hoken: “Iau te tagure no nian. Iau te sapak ira nugu tamat na bulumakau ing iau ga tamtabar hatamat diet. Muat mai um ukai tano nian. Ira linge bakut i te taguro.” ’
“Iesen diet pa ga song leh ira tultulai, diet gom haan harbasia. Tikai ga haan uram ra uno lalong, ma tikai ukaia tano uno pinapalim.
Ma ira mes ta diet ing diet ga kap ra sibik na lamaas, diet ga palim kawase ira uno tultulai, diet gaam gil hagahe diet, ma diet gaam bu bing diet.
No tamat na lualua na gil harkurai ga manga ngalngaluan, gaam tule ira uno umri ma diet ga bu bing haliare kaike ra ut na harubu bingibing, ma diet ga hakarat no udiet taman.
“Io, ga tange ta ira uno tultulai bia, ‘No nian na hinartola i taguro. Iesen ing iau ga tar sibik na lamaas ta diet, iau nes bia ira udiet tintalen pai haruat tano nugu sinisip.
Kaik, muat na haan taar ta ira subaan diet la hanhanuat hurlungen kaia. Ma muat na tar sibik na lamaas ta si at mon ing muat na nas.’

Io, ira tultulai diet ga haan harbasia ta ira subaan, diet gaam lamus hulungan ira matanaiabar bakut ing diet ga nas leh. Ari bilai ma ari sakana tunotuno nalamin ta diet. Ma no hala na lukara ga hung ma ira wasire.
“Io, no tamat na lualua na gil harkurai ga haan laka ukaia narako tano nian wara nasnas ira wasire. Ma ga nas tupas leh tiga tunotuno pa ga sigam ta bilai na kiniasine wara hinahaan tano hinartola.
Ma no tamat na lualua na gil harkurai ga tange tana bia, ‘Tasigu, u laka hobihbih ukai? Pau sigam ta bilai na kiniasim. U te gil ronga.’ Iesen no tunotuno pa ga haruat wara balbalui.

“Io, no tamat na lualua na gil harkurai ga tange ta diet ing diet nas mur no gil nian bia, ‘Muat na wis pakur ira iruo limana ma ira iruo kakine, ma muat na se hasur ie uras nataman ra kankado, naga susuah ma na hatagiris na ngise kaia.’”
Io, Jisas ga hapataam no uno nianga, gaam tange bia, “God i tatau ira halengin, ma sen i gilamis leh a bar nong mon.”
Diet ga tiri Jisas bia i takodas bia diet na kul takis bia taie.
Io, ira Parisi diet ga haan laah, diet gaam wor tika bia diet na hakuni Jisas ta ira uno nianga.

Ma diet ga tule ira udiet bulu na harausur tika ma diet ing diet git murmur Herot, no tamat na lualua na gil harkurai, ukaia hone Jisas. Ma diet ga tange tana bia, “Tena harausur, mehet nunure bia a tutun na tunotuno ugu. Ma u la hausur tutun at tano sinisip tane God. Pau la turtur sen ma tikai kanong pau la songsong leh bia a mangana tunotuno sa tiga nong.
Io, nu hinawase mehet tano num lilik. I takodas bia dahat na kul tar no takis ta diet ing diet kure dahat bia taie?”
Iesen Jisas ga palai ta ira udiet sakana lilik, gaam tange ta diet bia, “Muat ira ut na harababo! Muat sip bia muat na hakuni iau warah?
Muat haminas tiga kinewa tagu nong di la kulkul takis mei.” Diet ga kap hawaat tiga siliwa ukaia ho ie.
Io, ga tiri diet, “A malalar i sige iakan ma a hinsa sige iakan?”

“Tano lualua ta ira udahat ut na harkurai,” diet ga balui. Io, ga tange ta diet, “Masa. Muat na tar ta ira ut na harkurai ira linge at ta ira ut na harkurai, ma muat na tar ta God ira linge at tane God.”
Ma bia diet ga hadade huo, diet ga karup ta ira nianga ga tange. Diet ga haan sukun ie, ma diet gaam haan laah um.
Diet ga tiri Jisas uta diet ing diet te maat, bia diet na lon balin bia taie.

Ma ta iakanong at mon ra bung ari Sadiusi ing diet la liklik bia nong i maat pa na tut hut balin, diet ga hanuat taar tane Jisas, diet gaam tiri ie bia, “Tena harausur, Moses ga tange hoken. Bia tiga tunaan i maat ma taie ta natine, io, no tasine balik na tole no uno makosa. Ma dir na hatahuat ta nati dir ma dir na kilam tar ta diet no hinsana no tasine nong i te maat.
Io, a liman ma iruo na haratasin ken ho mehet. No luena ga tola, gaam mat sukun no uno hahin, ma pa ga mon nati dir baak. Io, no makosa ga haan taar tano tasine.
Ga ngan mah huo tano airuo, ma no aitul, gaam tuk taar ta nong ga liman ma iruo mei ta ira tasine.
Ma bia diet bakut gate maat, no hahin mah um ga maat.
Io, bia ira minaat diet na lon huat balin tano bung na tuntunut hut, ta sige tun at um no hahin ta ira liman ma iruo? Kanong diet bakut, diet ga tole tar ie.”
Io, Jisas ga balu diet hoken: “Muat ronga kanong muat pai palai ta ira nianga tane God ing di ga pakat, ma muat pai nunure mah no dadas tane God.
Tano pakana bung na tuntunut hut baling ta ira minaat, diet pa na hartola. Diet na haruat ma ira angelo aram ra ula mawe.
Iesen, kaiken ni hinawase muat bia diet ing diet te maat, diet na tut hut balin bia taie. I tahut bia muat na lik leh ira nianga tane God ing di ga pakat tar ta muat uta ira hintubu dahat.
A tutun bia diet gate maat, iesen God ga tange bia, ‘Iau no God tane Abraham, no God tane Aisak, ma no God tane Iakop.’ Pataie bia God audiet ira minaat, sen bia a God audiet ira lilona.”
Ma bia ira tamat na matanaiabar diet ga hadade huo, diet ga karup ta ira uno harausur.
No harkurai i lua ta ira harkurai bakut.
Ma bia ira Parisi diet ga hadade bia Jisas ga balu timaan ira Sadiusi diet gaam tur kunkun, io, ira Parisi diet ga hanuat hurlungen.
Ma tikai nalamin ta diet, a keskes ie ta ira harkurai tane Moses, ga walar Jisas, gaam tiri hoken:
“Tena harausur, gahim no harkurai ta ira harkurai bakut tane God i manga tamat?”
Jisas ga balui, gaam tange bia, “‘Nu sip no Watong no num God ma no katim bakut, no num nilon bakut, ma no num lilik bakut.’
Iakan ra harkurai i tamat sakit ma i lua ta ira mes.
Ma nong iruo mei, aie mah huo. I tange hoken: ‘Nu marse tikai hoing u marse habaling at ugu.’
Ira harkurai bakut ma ira harausur ta ira tangesot, diet burena laah ta kaiken ra iruo hartula.”
I ngan tutun at hohe bia no Mesaia na bulu huat tane Dawit?
Ing bia ira Parisi diet ga kis hurlungen taar, Jisas ga tiri diet hoken:
“Muat lik hohe uta nong di kilam ie bia no Mesaia? Na bulu huat ta sige?” Diet ga balui bia, “Na bulu huat tane Dawit.”
Ga tange ta diet bia, “Iesen, muat nes baak! No Halhaliana Tanuo ga tar ira lilik tane Dawit kaik Dawit at gaam tange bia,

content.text: ‘No Watong ga tange ta nagu Watong:
“Nu kap no tamat na kinkinis kai tano kata na limagu,
tuk iau ni bul hasur ira num hiruo menapu ta ira lapar a kakim!” ’

content: Io, i nanaas bia menalua sakit Dawit at ga kilam no Mesaia bia, ‘Nagu Watong.’ Kaik i palai bia iakano Mesaia a bulumur ie tane Dawit ma aie mah no Watong.”
Io, tur leh um ta iakano bung, diet bakut diet ga barbarahon bia diet na tiri wa tiga linge.
